thread:
sam-sales: Heads up — Unfold Cloud (seed, YC S21) asked for an extended POC + extra credits. They want 90 days and ~12k in hosted credits to finish model integration.
alyssa-growth: Do we have a standard for YC/seed startups? usually 3 months + $5k but we can stretch for strong technical signal. what’s their ARR / traction?
sam-sales: Pre-rev, working on roadmap. CTO demoed latency numbers yesterday, super engaged. ask is mostly to cover dev time and infra while they validate.
deal-bot: eligibility check: startup_program=eligible, previous_promos=0, account_age<12mo. recommended_max_credit=8000.
marco-se: From a presales POV: they need dedicated token throughput for our GPU-backed models during POC. I can set up a short Dedicated trial on a t2-pool for 2 weeks for free to smoke-test latency. After that hosted credits cover usage. Also flagged a security q from them — they want SOC2 attestation + data residency notes.
sam-sales: @marco-se thanks. can you send the SOC2 doc and a short note about our data flows? they asked about logs retention for PII.
marco-se: will send. quick snippet I’ll include to the thread for the security team: ```we encrypt in transit + at rest, customer data kept per-tenant in S3 with 90d default retention, option to extend via support ticket.```
cecil-revops: Finance constraints: we can approve up to $10k in credits for seeded startups but need a 6-month advisory/intro ask or signup to partner program as a soft commit. If they refuse, cap is $5k. Need deal desk approval for anything >$10k.
emma-legal: If we attach a short-term credit grant, add this clause: "credits expire after 90 days and do not constitute a monetary refund; use is subject to standard TOS". Also if they request custom data residency/contracting we’ll need SOW + security addendum.
sam-sales: Proposal: offer 90 days, $10k hosted credits, 2-week Dedicated test instance, and require a 6-month partner check-in (no financial commit). If they agree to a 6-month check-in + logos/technical case study, increase to $12k. Thoughts?
aylssa-growth: (typo fix) @sam-sales I think that’s fair. emphasize that the case study helps ROI. :+1:
deal-bot: escalation note: request_credit_increase to $12k requires revops approval + partner-marketing opt-in. automatic approvals denied.
cecil-revops: I can greenlight $10k today. For $12k need marketing opt-in + basic LOI (one paragraph) that they may participate in a case study. If they sign LOI, set credit grant to $12k and we’ll log a partner flag.
marco-se: I’ll prep the SOC2 + data flow note and a quick Dedicated test playbook (commands, expected metrics). sample playbook: ```1) deploy test model on t2-pool
2) run latency sweep (100 qps, 512 tokens)
3) capture percentiles + KV cache hit rate
4) follow up with optimization suggestions```
sam-sales: Great. I’ll reply to the customer with the $10k offer and the $12k conditional path. I’ll ask for the LOI and their security questionnaire (they sent a .docx).
emma-legal: If they send a security questionnaire, forward to eng-security@redwood and cc me. For LOI template, use the standard one-pager in /docs/sales/loi-template (internal).
sam-sales: Noted. tagging @cecil-revops to sign off on the $10k grant so I can issue credits.
cecil-revops: Signed off for $10k. Please include the standard credit grant email and expiration date (90 days). I’ll add partner flag after LOI.
sam-sales: Thanks all — I’ll update when LOI arrives and attach SOC2 docs. :rocket:
